title.en: An Act Authorizing the Expenditure From the Friar Lands Funds and the San Lazaro Estate Fund of the Necessary Amounts for the Acquisition of Equipment and Public Works During the Calendar Year Nineteen Hundred and Twenty-Two

text.en:
The expenditures of the following amounts are hereby authorized from the Friar Lands Funds
and the San Lazaro Estate Fund for the calendar year nineteen hundred and twenty-two, in addition to the
appropriation contained in sections 1-FF and GG of Act Numbered Twenty-nine hundred and ninety-seven:
FF. - FRIAR LANDS DIVISION
Furniture and Furniture
23
Purchase of furniture and equipment
Total for furniture and equipment
_______
======
Public works
24
Maintenance and repair of buildings
1,000
25
Maintenance, alteration, and repair of irrigation system and ditches
70,000
Total for public works
_______
71,000
Total additional appropriation for the Friar Lands Division to be paid out of its receipts
71,600
=======
GG. SAN LAZARO ESTATE
Furniture and Equipment

14
Purchase of furniture and equipment
200
Total additional appropriation for San Lazaro Estate to be paid from its receipts
_______
200
=======

This Act shall take effect on January first, nineteen hundred and twenty-two.
Approved, March 8, 1922.
